scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:run: npm run android:sync && npx cap run android
scripts.android: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios: node -e "console.log('iOS build needs a Mac and Xcode. On Windows: npm run ios:sync (keeps the project current). On a Mac: npx cap open ios')"
